economic_hypothesis: A volume-confirmed breakout in a PIT-observable sector bull freezes the old 20-session ceiling as a support reference. A subsequent lower-volume pullback that first closes below that reference and then causally reclaims it transfers risk from the breakout buyer to a support-tested entry at a lower price.
independence: No gap-repair or collapse-zone identity is used.
mother_breakout: signal-close ret120>0; prior60 return>8%; completed close>=prior completed 20-session high; daily return in [2.5%,9.5%]; close location>65%; turnover/prior20 mean>1.20; PIT market guard and PIT industry median/breadth leadership
pullback: 3-15 exchange sessions after mother; minimum low at least 5% below mother high; average turnover through reclaim below mother turnover
reclaim_trigger: immediately prior completed close below frozen support and current completed close>=support; current return in (0%,6%]; close location>55%; signal close<=1.02*mother high; PIT market/industry not structurally broken
deduplication: one signal per symbol-date; use the most recent qualifying mother
coordinate_lineage: mother and reclaim signal must have identical hard-valid corporate-action coordinate lineage; mismatch is rejected fail-closed
entry: first legal daily open strictly after decision, within three exchange sessions
capacity_rank: lower pullback average turnover relative to mother
higher reclaim close relative to frozen support

predeclared_exit_space.X1: after T+1, first completed close below 0.98*frozen support; sell next legal open
predeclared_exit_space.X2: after T+1, two consecutive completed exchange-session closes below frozen support; sell next legal open
